metas.name: Verity
metas.description: A ghostwriter moves into a bestselling author's house and finds a manuscript full of disturbing confessions. It's a twisty domestic thriller about obsession and a toxic marriage, the kind of glossy, nasty suspense he tends to finish in one sitting.

metas.name: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
metas.description: A director remaking a slasher becomes obsessed with the original film's final girl. It's a strange, sexy and unsettling new horror film about identity and fixation.

metas.name: It Ends
metas.description: Friends on a late-night food run get stuck on a highway that never ends while something waits outside the car. It's eerie liminal-space horror that rests on dread and mystery more than jump scares.

metas.name: Bad Apples
metas.description: A worn-out schoolteacher's choices get darker and darker after one of her students is hurt. It's a pitch-black comic thriller about an ordinary person going off the rails.

metas.name: The Plague
metas.description: An awkward tween goes through the cruel pecking order of a summer water polo camp, and his anxiety turns into psychological horror. It's an uneasy portrait of an outsider being bullied.

metas.name: Hope
metas.description: Something unknown turns up outside a remote harbor town and the residents have to fight to survive. It's a big new creature thriller that mixes action with real horror.

metas.name: Buddy
metas.description: A girl and her friends try to escape a children's TV show that has turned sinister. It's a new horror film with a creepy, playful premise and well-reviewed scares.

metas.name: Primetime
metas.description: A dramatization of a 2006 TV host's push to make the predator-sting show a hit. It's a darkly fascinating new take on media, ego and true crime.

metas.name: The Invite
metas.description: A couple whose marriage is falling apart invite their mysterious upstairs neighbors to dinner, and the evening spirals. It's a tense, funny relationship drama where the awkwardness keeps building.

metas.name: Leviticus
metas.description: Two teenage boys are hunted by an entity that takes the form of the person each one desires most. It's a new horror film about longing and shame among teenagers.
